candidate_mechanism.scope: Server-authoritative exact root fields that coordinator policy explicitly names; do not register any new callback in this work.
candidate_mechanism.input: Original player root NBT, fresh player root NBT, wasDeath, typed approved field policy; no client payload.
candidate_mechanism.output: Detached copies of eligible original owned fields only; no rewards, recipe grants, effects, teleport or stats reconciliation inside transfer.
candidate_mechanism.policy_source: Use referenced coordinator policy as review input, not generated allow-all prefix or updated master list. Event UUID receipt remains separately reviewable.
candidate_mechanism.type_policy: Check exact Tag kind and UUID representation before reading; absent/wrong type is not equivalent to numeric zero/false. No invented conversion for malformed historical data.
candidate_mechanism.owner_policy: Never put/replace/merge PlayerPersisted, dynastyCod4, DynastyArmyV1 or school/slot/secret-owned compounds. Leave already retained armor deadlines/generations identical.
candidate_mechanism.copy_policy: Tag.copy for each approved key, destination owned object separate from original; do not copy whole root or use reviveCaps for plain root NBT.
candidate_mechanism.reason_policy: Death and nondeath Clone both need explicit acceptance. A disk-save field is not automatically eligible to cross death.
candidate_mechanism.conflict_policy: Existing nondefault destination value that conflicts with original is an unresolved callback-order decision; do not silently add/max/merge or enable production before coordinator resolves it.

cooldown rebasing or granting fresh protection
network deserialization of arbitrary player root
